LF_ShopPriceRule.key: The rule's key is a prefab-path substring, or type:<flags>,mode:<mode> to match by arsenal type (mode defaults to 2, any). A key no shipped rule has adds a rule; an existing key changes only the fields given.

LF_VehiclePriceEntry.key: The key is the vehicle's prefab GUID (16 hex digits, the lot's vanilla car or its locked child). A GUID no shipped vehicle has adds one, which must set basePrice. An existing key changes only the fields given; an override of -1 derives the price.

LF_CrimeEntry.key: The key is the crime id, a localization key such as #LF-Offence_Robbery; saved crime records use the same string. An id no shipped entry has adds an offence at the end; an existing id changes only the fields given.
